description_en: Modifies the configurations of an access control policy
description_zh: 修改安全访问控制策略的配置信息
name: ModifyControlPolicy

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token
parameters.help_zh: 幂等标识
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a dry run
parameters.help_zh: 预检模式
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The action that Cloud Firewall performs on traffic in the access control policy. Valid values:
accept: Allows the traffic.
drop: Denies the traffic.
log: Monitors the traffic
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中流量通过云防火墙的方式。取值：
accept：放行
drop：拒绝
log：观察
parameters.name: acl_action

parameters.help_en:
The application type supported by the access control policy. Valid values:

ANY
HTTP
HTTPS
MySQL
SMTP
SMTPS
RDP
VNC
SSH
Redis
MQTT
MongoDB
Memcache
SSL

ANY indicates that the policy applies to all application types.

You must specify either ApplicationNameList or ApplicationName. They cannot be both empty. If both are specified, ApplicationNameList takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略支持的应用类型。支持的应用类型有以下几种：

ANY
HTTP
HTTPS
MySQL
SMTP
SMTPS
RDP
VNC
SSH
Redis
MQTT
MongoDB
Memcache
SSL

ANY表示策略应用在所有类型的应用中。

ApplicationNameList和ApplicationName二选一，必须传其中一个，不能同时为空。当ApplicationNameList和ApplicationName同时传值时，以ApplicationNameList为准
parameters.name: application_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the access control policy
parameters.help_zh: 安全访问控制策略的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The destination port for traffic in the access control policy
parameters.help_zh: 安全访问控制策略中流量访问的目的端口
parameters.name: dest_port

parameters.help_en:
The destination address in the access control policy.

If DestinationType is set to net, Destination is the destination CIDR block. Example: 1.2.XX.XX/24.
If DestinationType is set to group, Destination is the name of the destination address book. Example: db_group.
If DestinationType is set to domain, Destination is the destination domain name. Example: *.aliyuncs.com.
If DestinationType is set to location, Destination is the destination area (for the positional encoding of specific areas, see below). Example: ["BJ11", "ZB"]
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中的目的地址。

当DestinationType为net时，Destination为目的CIDR。例如：1.2.XX.XX/24
当DestinationType为group时，Destination为目的地址簿名称。例如：db_group
当DestinationType为domain时，Destination为目的域名。例如：*.aliyuncs.com
当DestinationType为location时，Destination为目的区域（具体区域位置编码见后文）。例如： ["BJ11", "ZB"]
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination address in the access control policy. Valid values:

net: destination CIDR block
group: destination address book
domain: destination domain name
location: destination region
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中的目的地址类型。取值：

net：目的网段（CIDR）
group：目的地址簿
domain：目的域名
location：目的区域
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en:
The traffic direction of the access control policy. Valid values:

in: inbound traffic
out: outbound traffic
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略的流量方向。取值：

in：外对内流量访问控制
out：内对外流量访问控制
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of traffic in the access control policy. Valid values:

ANY
TCP
UDP
ICMP

ANY indicates that the policy applies to all protocol types.

If the traffic direction is outbound and the destination address is a threat intelligence address book or cloud service address book of the domain name type, you can set this parameter to TCP or ANY. If you select TCP, you can set the application to HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, SMTPS, or SSL. If you select ANY, you can set the application to ANY
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中流量访问的安全协议类型。支持的应用类型有以下几种：

ANY
TCP
UDP
ICMP

ANY表示策略应用在所有类型的应用中。

流量方向为出向时，访问的目的地址为域名类型的威胁情报地址簿或云服务地址簿时，可选配置TCP/ANY协议。选择TCP时，应用可选HTTP/HTTPS/SMTP/SMTPS/SSL五种，选择ANY时，应用可选ANY
parameters.name: proto

parameters.help_en:
The source address in the access control policy.

If SourceType is set to net, Source is the source CIDR block. Example: 1.2.XX.XX/24.
If SourceType is set to group, Source is the name of the source address book. Example: db_group.
If SourceType is set to location, Source is the source area (for the positional encoding of specific areas, see below). Example: ["BJ11", "ZB"]
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中的源地址。

当SourceType为net时，Source为源CIDR。例如：1.2.XX.XX/24
当SourceType为group时，Source为源地址簿名称。例如：db_group
当SourceType为location时，Source为源区域（具体区域位置编码见后文）。例如["BJ11", "ZB"]
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the access control policy.

To modify an access control policy, you must provide its UUID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138866.html operation to obtain the UUID
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略的唯一标识ID。

修改安全访问控制策略，需要提供该策略的唯一标识ID，该ID可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138866.html接口获取
parameters.name: acl_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The type of the source address in the access control policy. Valid values:

net: source CIDR block
group: source address book
location: source region
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中的源地址类型。取值：

net：源网段（CIDR）
group：源地址簿

location：源区域
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination port for traffic in the access control policy. Valid values:

port: port
group: port address book
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中流量访问的目的端口类型。取值：

port：端口
group：端口地址簿
parameters.name: dest_port_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the destination port address book for traffic in the access control policy
parameters.help_zh: 安全访问控制策略中流量访问的目的端口地址簿名称
parameters.name: dest_port_group

parameters.help_en:
The status of the access control policy. Valid values:

true: enabling status.
false: shutdown
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略的状态。取值：

true：策略开启状态
false：策略关闭状态
parameters.name: release

parameters.help_en:
The list of application names.

You must specify either ApplicationNameList or ApplicationName. They cannot be both empty. If both are specified, ApplicationNameList takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
应用名称列表。

ApplicationNameList和ApplicationName二选一，必须传其中一个，不能同时为空。当ApplicationNameList和ApplicationName同时传值时，以ApplicationNameList为准
parameters.name: application_name_list

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence type of the Policy Validity Period for the access control policy. Valid values:
Permanent (default): always
None: single occurrence
Daily: daily
Weekly: weekly
Monthly: monthly
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复类型。取值：
Permanent（默认）：总是
None：指定单次时间
Daily：每天
Weekly：每周
Monthly：每月
parameters.name: repeat_type

parameters.help_en:
The collection of recurrence days for the Policy Validity Period of the access control policy.
If RepeatType is set to `Permanent`, `None`, or `Daily`, RepeatDays is an empty set. Example: [].
If RepeatType is set to Weekly, RepeatDays cannot be empty. Example: [0, 6].
When the RepeatType Settings is Weekly, the values in RepeatDays cannot be duplicate.
If RepeatType is set to `Monthly`, RepeatDays cannot be empty. Example: [1, 31].
When the RepeatType Settings is Monthly, the values in RepeatDays cannot be duplicate
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复日期集合。
当RepeatType为`Permanent`、`None`、`Daily`时，RepeatDays为空集合。
  例如：[]
当RepeatType为Weekly时，RepeatDays不能为空。
  例如：[0, 6]
RepeatType设置为Weekly时，RepeatDays不允许重复。
当RepeatType为`Monthly`时，RepeatDays不能为空。
  例如：[1, 31]
RepeatType设置为Monthly时，RepeatDays不允许重复
parameters.name: repeat_days

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence start time when the policy takes effect. Use the 24-hour time format HH:mm, such as 08:00.
If RepeatType is set to Permanent or None, RepeatStartTime is empty. If RepeatType is set to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, RepeatStartTime must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
策略生效的重复开始时间。使用HH:mm格式的24小时制时间，如08:00。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatStartTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatStartTime必须有值，您需要设置重复开始时间
parameters.name: repeat_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence end time when the policy takes effect. Use the 24-hour time format HH:mm, such as 23:00.
If RepeatType is set to Permanent or None, RepeatEndTime is empty. If RepeatType is set to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, RepeatEndTime must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
策略生效的重复结束时间。使用HH:mm格式的24小时制时间，如23:00。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatEndTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatEndTime必须有值，您需要设置重复结束时间
parameters.name: repeat_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the Policy Validity Period for the access control policy. The value is expressed in the format of a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time must be on the hour or half-hour, and must be at least 30 minutes earlier than the end time.
When RepeatType is Permanent, StartTime is empty. When RepeatType is None, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, StartTime must have a value, and you need to configure the start time Settings
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且小于结束时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，StartTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，StartTime必须有值，您需要设置开始时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the Policy Validity Period for the access control policy. The value is expressed in the format of a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time must be on the hour or half-hour, and must be at least 30 minutes later than the start time.
When RepeatType is Permanent, EndTime is empty. When RepeatType is None, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, EndTime must have a value, and you need to configure the end time Settings
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且大于开始时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，EndTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，EndTime必须有值，您需要设置结束时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The domain name resolution mode of the access control policy. Valid values:

FQDN: FQDN
DNS: DNS-based dynamic resolution
FQDN_AND_DNS: FQDN and DNS-based dynamic resolution
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的域名解析方式。取值：

FQDN：基于FQDN
DNS：基于DNS动态解析
FQDN_AND_DNS：基于FQDN与DNS动态解析
parameters.name: domain_resolve_type

DryRun.description_en: Indicates whether the dry run is successful. A value of true indicates that only the dry run is performed and no actual modifications are made
DryRun.description_zh: 标识本次为 DryRun 预检成功响应；true 表示仅完成预检、未执行真实修改
